info.title: SammaPix API — Image & PDF processing for AI agents
info.description: Agent-native image and PDF processing. Deterministic ops (compress, convert, resize, crop, rotate, watermark, PDF compress/split/merge/rotate, image-to-PDF), AI vision (describe, alt text, OCR, tags, filename, document extraction) and a pipeline that chains image ops in one call. Pay-as-you-go with a free daily tier, zero-retention (files processed in memory and discarded). Also available as a remote MCP server at /api/mcp (OAuth 2.1, no API key to paste).

post.summary: Run one image or PDF operation
post.description: Send a file (multipart 'file' field) or JSON ({ image: base64|dataURL } or { url }). Returns the processed file (binary) for most ops, or JSON for metadata/pdf-info/describe/alt-text/suggest-filename/ocr/tags/extract-document. Billing: 1 credit per op, 2 for AI vision ops; a failed op is refunded. Free daily tier applies first. KEYLESS FREE TRIAL: deterministic ops (compress, resize, crop, convert, rotate, flip, grayscale, blur, adjust, tint, negate, flatten, border, round, watermark, metadata, optimize-web, pdf-compress, pdf-split, pdf-rotate, pdf-info) can be called a few times/day per IP with NO API key (max 5MB) to try before signing up. AI ops always require a key.

file.description: The input image or PDF. For pdf-merge and image-to-pdf, repeat the 'file' field for multiple files.

format.description: Target format for convert/optimize-web (webp, avif, jpeg, png).

image.description: Base64 or data URL of the input image.

url.description: Public URL of the input image (fetched securely).

200.description: Processed file (binary) or JSON result. Response headers include x-op-cost and x-credits-remaining.

402.description: Insufficient credits. Body includes cost and remaining.

422.description: Operation failed on valid input (credits refunded).

post.summary: Chain multiple image operations in one call
post.description: Runs an ordered list of image ops (the output of each feeds the next) and returns only the final image. Saves round-trips and tokens. Billed 1 credit per step. Chainable ops: compress, resize, crop, convert, rotate, flip, grayscale, blur, adjust, tint, negate, flatten, border, round, watermark.

steps.description: JSON array of { op, params }, e.g. [{"op":"resize","params":{"width":1200}},{"op":"convert","params":{"format":"webp","quality":80}}]. Max 12 steps.

bearerAuth.description: API key as 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...'. Generate one at https://www.sammapix.com/dashboard/api. Agents can also connect over MCP at /api/mcp with OAuth 2.1 (no key to paste).
